subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

The sound of elephants
solution:
The correct answer is: **Trumpet**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**trumpet**" means to make a loud, clear sound, like that of an elephant. (हाथी की तरह तेज़, स्पष्ट आवाज़ निकालना)
 
• It is a verb that can also refer to a musical instrument that produces a similar sound.
 
• In this context, "**trumpet**" is the most appropriate word to describe the sound of elephants.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Quack **refers to the sound made by ducks. (बत्तखों द्वारा निकाली गई ध्वनि)
 
• **Laurel **is a type of tree and is not related to any sound. (एक प्रकार का वृक्ष और इसका किसी ध्वनि से कोई संबंध नहीं है)
 
• **Screech **refers to a high-pitched, harsh sound made by birds or tires. (पक्षियों या टायरों द्वारा बनाई गई ऊँची, कठोर ध्वनि)
